# KovaLab

> A software solutions studio in Kenya, building websites, online shops and web applications for Kenyan businesses. Business websites start from KSh 15,000 for up to 3 pages. Domain registration and hosting are billed separately. WhatsApp ordering and integrated payments are scoped according to the project; a WhatsApp order does not confirm payment.

## Services
- [Website design](https://www.kovalab.co.ke/services/website-design): mobile-friendly business websites
- [Web applications](https://www.kovalab.co.ke/services/web-applications): online shops, booking systems and customer portals
- [Custom software](https://www.kovalab.co.ke/services/custom-software): business workflows and integrations
- [SEO setup](https://www.kovalab.co.ke/services/seo-setup): search foundations for your website
